# ui::Color

Header: `winui/core/Color.hpp`.

An RGBA color with float channels in 0..1 and straight (non-premultiplied) alpha.

The value type every brush, theme palette entry and render command uses. Channels hold the sRGB-encoded values as authored (not linearized); [`a`](#a) defaults to opaque. Build one from 8-bit channels with [from_rgba()](#from_rgba), [from_rgb()](#from_rgb) or [from_argb()](#from_argb), or use a named constant from `colors`.

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::Color accent = ui::Color::from_argb(0xFF0078D4);
const ui::Color hover  = ui::lerp(accent, ui::colors::White, 0.2f);

window.set_content(ui::Button{
    .text       = "Save",
    .background = hover.with_alpha(0.9f),
    .foreground = ui::colors::White,
});
```

## r

```cpp
float r = 0.0f
```

Red, 0..1.

## g

```cpp
float g = 0.0f
```

Green, 0..1.

## b

```cpp
float b = 0.0f
```

Blue, 0..1.

## a

```cpp
float a = 1.0f
```

Straight alpha, 0 (transparent) .. 1 (opaque).

## Color

```cpp
constexpr Color() = default
```

Opaque black.

## Color

```cpp
constexpr Color(std::floating_point auto red, std::floating_point auto green, std::floating_point auto blue)
```

From float channels in 0..1, opaque: `ui::Color{1.0f, 0.5f, 0.0f}`.

## Color

```cpp
constexpr Color(std::floating_point auto red, std::floating_point auto green, std::floating_point auto blue, std::floating_point auto alpha)
```

From float channels and alpha in 0..1: `ui::Color{1.0f, 0.5f, 0.0f, 0.5f}`.

## Color

```cpp
template <std::integral R, std::integral G, std::integral B, std::integral... A>
constexpr Color(R, G, B, A...)
    requires (sizeof...(A) <= 1)
```

Integer channels do not compile: `Color{255, 128, 0}` would be white, since a channel is 0..1. 8-bit channels go through [from_rgb()](#from_rgb) or [from_rgba()](#from_rgba).

## with_alpha

```cpp
Color with_alpha(float alpha) const
```

A copy with [`a`](#a) replaced by `alpha` (0..1, not clamped); r/g/b are untouched.

## from_rgba

```cpp
static Color from_rgba(std::uint8_t r8, std::uint8_t g8, std::uint8_t b8, std::uint8_t a8 = 255)
```

Construct from 8-bit sRGB channels (0..255); alpha defaults to opaque.

## from_argb

```cpp
static Color from_argb(std::uint32_t argb)
```

Construct from a packed 0xAARRGGBB value (`#AARRGGBB` order), so `0xFF0078D4` is an opaque blue. A value written as 0xRRGGBB has alpha 0 and is fully transparent. Use [from_rgb()](#from_rgb) for that.

## from_rgb

```cpp
static Color from_rgb(std::uint32_t rgb)
```

Construct an opaque color from a packed 0xRRGGBB value (`#RRGGBB`), so `0x0078D4` is the same blue. Bits above the low 24 are ignored.

## from_rgb

```cpp
static Color from_rgb(std::uint8_t r8, std::uint8_t g8, std::uint8_t b8)
```

Construct an opaque color from 8-bit sRGB channels (0..255): `from_rgb(0, 120, 212)`.
